_comment: The teaching benchmark and peer outcomes that earn the meeting. THESE ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Replace every number and claim here with verified Intradiem proof points before anything sends. Never send an unverified stat or customer claim. Use categories, never a real customer's name, unless you have explicit reference approval.

insight_tail: and most of it isn't breaks, it's the seconds between scheduled activities that nothing is watching
